title: Panzer Dragoon
japaneseTitle: パンツァードラグーン
shortDescription: Team Andromeda's breathtaking 360-degree rail-shooter launch title for the Sega Saturn, defined by Moebius-inspired art direction and an orchestral score.
historicalSignificance: A crowning showcase for the artistic ambition of fifth-generation CD-ROM gaming, introducing a 360-degree rotational camera system, a fictional spoken language, and establishing the cult-classic Panzer Dragoon universe.

editorialContent.overview: Set in a melancholic, post-apocalyptic fantasy world where bio-engineered ruins decay amidst sweeping desert wastes, hunter Keil Fluge bonds with an armored Blue Dragon to prevent a rogue Black Dragon from unlocking an ancient monolith.
editorialContent.gameplay: Revolutionized rail shooters by introducing four directional camera perspectives (Front, Left, Back, Right), allowing players to spin 360 degrees to lock onto targets with homing lasers while avoiding laser barrages.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Demonstrated the raw 3D polygon capabilities of the dual-SH2 processors in the Sega Saturn alongside Yoshitaka Azuma's sweeping orchestral score.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: French comic master Moebius (Jean Giraud) contributed official cover art and concept designs, cementing the game as a high-art interactive benchmark.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on original Sega Saturn CD-ROMs, remade for modern consoles in 2020.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Flagship launch title for the Sega Saturn hardware line
awards: Electronic Gaming Monthly Best Saturn Game of 1995

technicalSpecs.resolution: 320 x 224 (3D textured polygons with dual VDP chips)
